message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Generate API from Spec
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 0" # Every Sunday at midnight GMT
jobs:
  generate-api:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'opensearch-project/opensearch-js' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ./api_generator
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
        with:
          submodules: recursive
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Config git to rebase
        run: git config --global pull.rebase true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '24'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Generate API
        run: |-
          npm run download_spec
          npm run generate_api

      - name: Get current date
        id: date
        run: echo "date=$(date +'%Y-%m-%d')" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@22a9089034f40e5a961c8808d113e2c98fb63676 # v7
        with:
          push-to-fork: opensearch-ci-bot/opensearch-js
          token: ${{ secrets.OPENSEARCH_CI_BOT_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Updated opensearch-js to reflect the latest OpenSearch API spec (${{ env.date }})"
          title: "[AUTOCUT] Update opensearch-js to reflect the latest OpenSearch API spec (${{ env.date }})"
          body: |
            Update `opensearch-js` to reflect the latest [OpenSearch API spec](https://api-spec.opensearch.org/opensearch-openapi.yaml).
            Date: ${{ env.date }}
          branch: update-api-from-spec-${{ env.date }}
          base: main
          signoff: true
          labels: |
            autocut",
  "rationale": "Apply P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: add an explicit job timeout to bound runaway consumption. The measured fork experiment for this pattern retained all successes (3/3) while adding timeout-minutes: 5, and the repository's scheduled runs historically complete in about 1-1.5 minutes, so a 5-minute budget preserves coverage with ample headroom. All steps, permissions, triggers, and the required-check contract are unchanged; no secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
